LanguageData.GC_DamageTip: When off, pawns are thrown harmlessly. When on, hard landings and wall hits injure them.
LanguageData.GC_LethalTip: When off, damage per hit is capped and stops once a pawn is badly hurt.
LanguageData.GC_FourthWall: Fourth wall: pawns react to the cursor
LanguageData.GC_FourthWallTip: Speech bubbles, attitude towards the cursor, nervousness, and slow realization that they live in a game.
LanguageData.GC_PanicTip: Scared pawns may enter a panic mental state after being thrown, hurt or poked. Off by default. A panicking pawn can be calmed by grabbing it, patting it (Ctrl+LMB) or with the 'Calm' button.
LanguageData.GC_Hints: Controls: LMB drag - pick up a pawn Release slowly - set down Release while moving - throw Shift+LMB - poke Ctrl+LMB - pat (also calms) Click without dragging - select
LanguageData.GC_MouseHold: Release to set down, flick to throw
LanguageData.GC_Milestone_1: {0} has started to suspect that something outside the world is moving them around.
LanguageData.GC_Milestone_2: {0} can now see the interface. Buttons, panels, a pointer. This is going to be awkward.
LanguageData.GC_Milestone_3: {0} has broken the fourth wall and knows about you.
LanguageData.GC_ForbidOffMapTip: When on, thrown pawns bounce off the map edge and panicking pawns are calmed before they can run away. When off, a pawn thrown past the edge leaves the map and may be lost for good.
LanguageData.GC_AmbientChatter: Pawns talk to themselves and to you
LanguageData.GC_AmbientChatterTip: Pawns that have noticed the cursor occasionally say something out loud, even when the mode is off. Requires the fourth wall option.
LanguageData.GC_HintIdle: Show a 'God cursor' label next to the cursor
LanguageData.GC_HintHover: Show pawn info when hovering over a pawn
LanguageData.GC_HintHold: Show a how-to hint while holding a pawn
LanguageData.GC_HintPanel: Show the controls help in the panel
LanguageData.GC_B_Grab_6: My feet! Where are my feet?!
LanguageData.GC_B_Grab_8: I was in the middle of something!
LanguageData.GC_B_Grab_12: I did NOT agree to this.
LanguageData.GC_B_Throw_3: This is not in my job description!
LanguageData.GC_B_Throw_8: I can see my house from here!
LanguageData.GC_B_Throw_9: Not the walls! Not the walls!
LanguageData.GC_B_Throw_11: I'm a bird! I'm a plane! I'm a colonist!
LanguageData.GC_B_Land_5: I could get used to this.
LanguageData.GC_B_Land_9: At least you put me down softly.
LanguageData.GC_B_Land_11: Is it over? It's over. Good.
LanguageData.GC_B_Landed_5: Am I still in one piece?
LanguageData.GC_B_Landed_7: That's a story for the grandkids.
LanguageData.GC_B_Landed_8: My dignity stayed back there somewhere.
LanguageData.GC_B_Landed_9: Note to self: hate the cursor.
LanguageData.GC_B_Landed_10: Did anyone see that? Please say no.
LanguageData.GC_B_Landed_11: Ten out of ten flight, zero out of ten landing.
LanguageData.GC_B_Hit_4: I felt that in my ancestors!
LanguageData.GC_B_Hit_8: That wall came out of nowhere!
LanguageData.GC_B_Hit_9: Ugh... the ground is so hard.
LanguageData.GC_B_Hit_10: Why would you do that to me?
LanguageData.GC_B_Hit_11: That's going to leave a mark.
LanguageData.GC_B_Pat_7: I won't tell anyone about this.
LanguageData.GC_B_Pat_11: Is this what being loved feels like?
LanguageData.GC_B_Poke_5: Was that a finger? A big finger?
LanguageData.GC_B_Poke_7: Quit it or I'll... I don't know what.
LanguageData.GC_B_Hover_Worship_1: The cursor graces me with its presence...
LanguageData.GC_B_Hover_Worship_2: I knew you'd come back, my lord.
LanguageData.GC_B_Hover_Worship_5: I'm ready for whatever you ask.
LanguageData.GC_B_Hover_Worship_6: Lift me up, o mighty one.
LanguageData.GC_B_Hover_Worship_8: I've kept the place clean for you.
LanguageData.GC_B_Hover_Worship_10: I told everyone about you. They didn't believe me.
LanguageData.GC_B_Hover_Friendly_5: Fancy a chat? I'll do the talking.
LanguageData.GC_B_Hover_Friendly_10: Nice to have someone looking out for us.
LanguageData.GC_B_Hover_Neutral_1: Why is that arrow looking at me?
LanguageData.GC_B_Hover_Neutral_3: What's that thing floating over me?
LanguageData.GC_B_Hover_Neutral_6: It's just a pointer. Just a pointer.
LanguageData.GC_B_Hover_Neutral_9: There's a tiny arrow over my head.
LanguageData.GC_B_Hover_Wary_1: Don't you dare pick me up.
LanguageData.GC_B_Hover_Wary_5: Nobody move. It hasn't seen us.
LanguageData.GC_B_Hover_Wary_9: One click and I'm airborne again...
LanguageData.GC_B_Hover_Wary_10: Is it going to grab me? It's going to grab me.
LanguageData.GC_B_Hover_Terror_5: Don't look at me! Don't look at me!
LanguageData.GC_B_Hover_Terror_9: I can't breathe. It's right there.
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta0_1: Did something just look at me?
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta0_4: There's a pattern to all this.
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta0_5: It's like someone is playing with us.
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta0_6: I swear the air just blinked.
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta1_1: The sky has an edge. I can see it.
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta1_3: We're inside a screen, aren't we?
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta1_4: Why does the world end in a straight line?
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta1_6: I counted. The days are... ticks.
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta1_7: Something decides what I do next.
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta1_8: Why do I walk the same path every day?
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta2_1: I can see the buttons. All the buttons.
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta2_4: Who's playing me? WHO IS PLAYING ME?
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta2_5: I know about the save button.
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta2_6: There's a speed control up there. Fast forward...
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta2_7: My life is a mouse click away.
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta3_1: I know you're there. It's okay.
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta3_3: Quit or don't, I'll still be here.
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta3_4: Thanks for the story so far.
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta3_5: Whatever you do next, I forgive you.
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta3_6: We both know how this ends. A mod menu.
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta3_7: Pssst. Can you give me a better trait?
LanguageData.GC_B_Meta3_8: I'm not mad. I'm just... enlightened.
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle0_2: I feel like I forgot something. Something big.
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle0_4: I could swear I was just standing over there.
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle1_2: Why are there invisible walls at the edge of the world?
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle1_3: Sometimes the whole world holds its breath.
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle1_4: Have you noticed how time speeds up sometimes?
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle1_5: I think we're being observed. Politely.
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle1_7: Somebody out there controls the weather.
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle1_8: I had a thought that wasn't mine.
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle2_1: Hey, you. Yes, you. With the mouse.
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle2_2: Could you please stop pausing mid-sentence?
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle2_3: I know there's a menu somewhere.
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle2_4: Don't tell the others what I know.
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle2_5: Are you the one deciding the raids?
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle2_6: Please send fewer raiders. Just a thought.
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle2_7: I can feel your finger on the button.
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle3_1: It's quiet in here. I like it.
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle3_2: Thanks for keeping the colony going.
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle3_3: If this is a game, I hope it's a good one.
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle3_4: I made peace with the fourth wall.
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle3_5: Take your time. I'm not going anywhere.
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle3_6: Do you ever get tired of watching?
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle3_7: It's okay to quit sometimes. We'll wait.
LanguageData.GC_B_Idle3_8: You're my favorite player. Don't tell the others.
LanguageData.GC_B_Edge_3: Not that way. Never that way.
LanguageData.GC_B_Edge_4: I almost left the map. Scary.
LanguageData.GC_B_Edge_5: Something pulled me back from the edge.
